common.scope: Child-friendly static stylized-inspired environment prop; no strict scientific reconstruction.
common.minimum_reference: Use a reliable named museum/specimen/institution or primary reference supporting recognizable basic form; existing ledger entries are retrieval leads with inherited access notes, not a new verification by this planning task. Group-only overview cannot prove a genus-specific diagnostic feature. No mandatory species/specimen matching beyond the basic form actually claimed.
common.reference_rights: Consulting facts does not require licensing a copied asset. References are consulted-only, with source URLs and actual access status retained. No reference media/scan/mesh is incorporated. If incorporating third-party media, record actual rights/license/permission first; the string consulted-only is not a third-party license grant. Prefer original geometry/maps and avoid this dependency.
common.continue_rule: Once reliable basic form and original/authorized inputs are established, proceed after the parent CI/claim gate. Do not repeatedly research or repair because color, restored soft tissue, pose, dimensions, plate/feather counts or fine reconstruction are uncertain. Label artistic choices.
common.block_only: A real basic identity contradiction, no reliable support for the named form actually claimed, unlicensed incorporated material, visibly broken proportion/connection at intended view, or failed required technical/delivery checks remains actionable. Narrow unsupported claims to the descriptive inspired-by fallback; do not invent sources or a factual PASS.
common.repair_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair as the inherited practical profile specifies; persistent required defects return to parent for scope/hold decision rather than an open-ended reconstruction campaign.

source_access: Inherited inventory evidence; not a new page/figure verification.

scope_notes.basic_rule: Reliable basic recognizable forms and original/actually authorized inputs suffice. No microscopic reconstruction or exact paleo-place/coexistence/behavior gate.
scope_notes.habitat_rule: Freshwater plants are not marine vegetation; early land plants, marine invertebrates and gliding reptile are separate teaching assets, not one co-occurring habitat.
scope_notes.promotion_rule: Four early deferred-only plant plans are reactivated in one current queue after no artifact/active-claim evidence; original deferred bundles remain provenance only, never duplicate executable jobs.
